title: Bytes on disk per project

metrics.name: disk.bytes
metrics.label: on disk
metrics.means: Total size of the project's local folders, excluding .git, node_modules and virtualenvs — what the working tree costs, not what its history does.

metrics.name: disk.worktree_bytes
metrics.label: in worktrees
metrics.means: Total bytes in the project's extra checkouts recorded in repositories[].local.extra_clones. Uses the same exclusions as disk.bytes, including reinstallable dependency directories. Kept separate so additional checkouts do not change the meaning of the primary working-tree series.

metrics.name: disk.reclaimable_bytes
metrics.label: reclaimable
metrics.means: Bytes in reinstallable directories excluded from disk.bytes, including node_modules, virtualenvs, build outputs and ecosystem caches, across the project's checkouts. This estimates recreatable disk usage; the metric itself deletes nothing.

why: Track source folders, additional checkouts and reinstallable dependencies separately. These measurements help identify disk growth and distinguish working files from data that can be recreated.
